BepInEx 6
# BepInEx 6.0.0-be.785. The test, and the first-run harness below, ran its BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Core.dll
# (sha256 352aacc2d5356489a00891f76db28b6463c81d25bcb02f90035171a669b7e35b), which the game loads.
# No published build shipped the plugin .cfg, in its ZIP or as a launcher-manifest.json seed (the one
# seed is the loader's BepInEx.cfg), so the input is what the build writes at its first start: the .cfg
# its own SonsOfTheForestHeadTracking.dll, taken from the dev pre-release's installer ZIP (the ZIP's
# SHA-256 checked against the digest GitHub reports for the asset), writes when its PluginConfig
# constructor runs on a ConfigFile at a path with no file and the plugin's BepInPlugin metadata
# (com.cameraunlock.sonsoftheforest.headtracking, Sons of the Forest Head Tracking, 0.1.0), as
# BasePlugin builds it. It ran on .NET 8 with that BepInEx.Core.dll and core's IL2CPP stub of
# UnityEngine.CoreModule for KeyCode. The "Acceptable values" comment lines list the stub's KeyCode
# enum; in game they list the one the game's interop assemblies hold. No reader reads a comment line.
